description: Pull xkcd comics into a workflow: the latest one, any comic by number, a random pick, or the comics from a stretch of the archive or a range of dates. Search all 3,000+ comics by title, hover text or transcript, check whether a new comic has gone up since last time, and download the picture to post or attach. Every comic comes back with its hover text: the joke that isn't in the image. No account or API key required.
